content: LWW clock-skew critique (multiple 2025-2026 articles + classic 'Clocks Are Bad'): pure wall-clock LWW is unsafe - skew lets stale writes overwrite newer ones, silently dropping updates and violating causality; LWW-register CRDTs still lose concurrent updates by design (one write discarded). Mitigations used in practice: hybrid logical clocks (HLC) bounding drift influence, deterministic tie-breaks (node ID), conflict surfacing (journals/observability), and documenting LWW as per-key atomic only. Known accepted tradeoff for config-style stores.
